barriers.name: ReadOnlyBrokerSession
barriers.implementation: write methods absent; __getattr__ denylist raises ShadowWriteForbiddenError for order_check/submit_order/cancel_order/close_position/order_send/modify_order

barriers.name: immutable deployment profile
barriers.implementation: TB-GENERIC-SHADOW-G1 profile hash persisted at startup; drift blocks

barriers.name: process capability denial
barriers.implementation: shadow process consumes exported market truth; no MT5 client, no broker credentials

conclusion: A broker write is impossible by construction: all four barriers must fail simultaneously, which is a hard design failure. Any single configuration mistake cannot enable orders.
